title: Minerals Compass
description: A compass that detects and shows the distance to nearby vanilla ores.
body:
# Materials Compass

**Materials Compass** is a simple and lightweight Minecraft mod that adds a new tool designed to help players locate **vanilla ores** more easily.

———

## Features
- Detects and tracks the nearest **vanilla ores** (Iron, Copper, Gold, Coal, etc.).
- Works both **above and below ground**
- Fully **client-side** — compatible with vanilla and Forge servers.
- Lightweight, optimized and stable - no performance impact.

———

## Technical Info
- **Minecraft version:** 1.20.1
- **Mod Loader:** Forge

———

## Current state
This is an **early** version (v0.0.1).
At the moment, the compas functions mainly as a **prototype** and is only accessible through **Creative Mode**.
Future updates will include:
- Ore selection through a GUI.
- Integration with survival gameplay.
- Customizable detection range and visual indicators.

———

## Language
- English
- Spanish

## Notes
Feedback and ideas are welcome!
You can share suggestions or report issues on the GitHub project page
